name: Lightbox
description: A framework-free Web Component that turns a gallery of links into a full viewer, with magnification by wheel, button and key, dragging once magnified, and a thumbnail strip that scrolls on its own arrows.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A grid of pictures that opens into the viewer, built on links that still work with no script.

variants.name: Zoom
variants.description: Magnifying by wheel, by button and by key, magnifying towards the pointer, and dragging once magnified.

variants.name: Navigation
variants.description: A strip long enough to need its end arrows, following the current picture back into view, in a set that loops.

variants.name: Captions
variants.description: Pictures carrying a caption beside the alternative text that a caption never replaces.

variants.name: Aspect
variants.description: Tall, wide and square pictures in one set, cropped in the grid and shown whole in the viewer.

variants.name: Single
variants.description: One picture, where the arrows and the strip are removed rather than turned off.
